root_cause: Goal scenarios and roadmap actions existed, but verified realized effects did not yet calibrate future scenario guidance.
prevention_rule: Keep raw scenario assumptions immutable. Require at least three verified quantified outcomes per goal/lever before applying a historical calibration factor. Project calibrated effects separately from raw assumptions and keep Outcomes & evidence as the measurement authority.

evidence.outcome: Verified realized effects can calibrate future goal scenarios only after sufficient repeated evidence, while raw assumptions remain separately visible.
